title: Vertex AI: Critical Breaking Changes & Extensive API Expansion
summary: Vertex AI has introduced significant breaking changes, making numerous API parameters strictly required and many resource properties read-only. Developers must update their code to avoid disruptions. This release also includes a substantial expansion of API schemas, indicating a broad rollout of new features across AI services.
details: This update brings critical breaking changes. Many API methods now enforce strict requirements for previously optional parameters, including resource identifiers like `name`, `parent`, `endpoint`, `model`, `dataset`, `featurestore`, `index`, `artifact`, `context`, `execution`, and `tensorboard` across various services. Existing API calls omitting these will now fail. Additionally, a large number of properties within core schemas (e.g., `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1Agent.created`, `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1BatchPredictionJob.completionStats`, `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1Model.createTime`) have transitioned to read-only or immutable status, preventing modification attempts. Beyond these necessary code adjustments, the API surface has expanded dramatically with numerous new schemas, particularly for advanced vision models and detailed configuration options, suggesting a significant enhancement of Vertex AI's capabilities.
